words.example: The elective admission was moved to make room for an emergency.
words.exampleZh: 这次择期入院被调整了，以便给急诊腾床。

words.example: A consent form without a date will be sent back by the checker.
words.exampleZh: 没有日期的知情同意书会被检查人退回。

words.example: Please confirm the insurance plan before the elective admission.
words.exampleZh: 择期入院之前，请先确认医保保险方案。

words.example: Patients pay the copay at the cashier before they see the doctor.
words.exampleZh: 患者见医生之前，先在收费处交自付费用。

words.example: Billing queried a charge that belonged to another visit.
words.exampleZh: 计费收费部门质疑了一笔属于另一次就诊的费用。

words.example: The snapshot replica of PACS is six hours behind the main copy.
words.exampleZh: 影像的快照副本比主副本慢了六个小时。

words.example: Replication to the east site paused after a short network blip.
words.exampleZh: 网络抖了一下之后，发往东院的数据复制暂停了。

words.example: The sync job for staff photos failed halfway through the night.
words.exampleZh: 员工照片的同步任务在半夜做到一半失败了。

words.example: Bandwidth usage on the PACS link peaks when CT sends large studies.
words.exampleZh: CT传送大检查时，影像链路上的带宽占用会到峰值。

words.example: Packet loss on the ward uplink made the order screen freeze.
words.exampleZh: 病区上联线路的丢包把医嘱界面卡住了。
